summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep private. Official API access is evidenced, but rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; current public terms point against those uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, privacy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible fleet growth is conditional where consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Revenue evidence covers one day: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed; ROI and margin remain unknown.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial evidence includes official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level source rights, alert identifiers and data flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 consent/settings/retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures; keep the permission request unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate or advertising permission. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Fleet compliance, data quality, analytics, revenue, and site evidence do not support a general legal clearance. Compliance failures and unknowns require site-specific remediation or evidence; analytics permissions and collector errors remain data-quality issues, not automatic launch blockers. Preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed, do not infer telemetry, claims, rights, copyright/trademark clearance, age suitability, or regulated-use compliance from domain names or portfolio labels. Private or gated properties require an explicit keep-private decision and completed launch checklist before exposure or monetization.

Retain only existing reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, bounded security-evidence, and private-launch workstreams. No new production work, telemetry request, spend, requeue, monetization, or external outreach is legally justified on current evidence.
